IP & Innovation Programme

Verify a UKABCS Certificate

Enter the serial number printed on a UKABCS Certificate of Copyright & Innovation Registration to view the certificate and confirm that it is genuine.

Certificate verification

Every certificate issued by UKABCS has a unique serial number, for example UKABCS-CR-2026-XXXX-XXXX. Enter it below to see the certificate exactly as UKABCS issued it.

Want to see how it works? Try the specimen serial .

Valid certificate
SPECIMEN

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science

Certificate

of Copyright & Innovation Registration

This is to certify that

Dr. Full Name

Position, Institution

has registered the work entitled

“Title of the Registered Work”

with the UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science on 27 November 2026.
The work is held on record by UKABCS as evidence of its content, authorship and date.

UKABCS

UK Organisation for Biotechnology and Computational Science (UKABCS) is a UK-registered non-profit academic society dedicated to peer-reviewed research, transparent grant funding, and open-access scientific education.
